subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving first deposits for {Brand} the way Coinbase and Kraken buy US paid, on the deposit rather than the install. The one point worth repeating: we optimize MAFO to the funded account and read it back through a post-KYC funded-event postback, so what you pay for is cleared deposits with bonus-only and airdrop-farmer sign-ups clawed back first, holding near an eCPA of $35 on the deposit. If it helps, I can pull the sign-up-to-deposit breakdown for your funnel. Worth a quick look?
illustrative_flags: eCPA of $35 on the deposit (MobUpps-specific cost per first deposit; illustrative, never an established result)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN crypto_and_trading: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (first-deposit optimization + post-KYC funded-event postback + clawback of bonus-only/airdrop-farmer); one illustrative MobUpps figure (eCPA $35 on the deposit); reuses only parent brands (Coinbase, Kraken); native EN register, no transliteration; soft CTA, 1 question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no X-not-Y (positive 'on the deposit rather than the install').
